usage: RC.audio.sfx(name) plays sfx_<name>.mp3; volumes in CLIP_GAIN (js/audio.js); synth fallback if a clip fails to load

rimhit.prompt: Basketball hitting the metal rim of a hoop, sharp metallic clang with a short ring, indoor gym

bounce.prompt: Single basketball bounce on a hardwood gym floor, punchy rubber thud with a little gym echo

swish.prompt: Basketball swishing cleanly through a nylon net, soft quick swish

whoosh.prompt: Quick soft whoosh of a basketball being thrown through the air

murmur.prompt: Small group of kids gasping and murmuring in surprise in an indoor gym, short crowd reaction, no clear words

cheer.prompt: Small group of children cheering and clapping briefly in a school gym

press.prompt: Soft playful UI button click pop for a kids game, short and clean

hover.prompt: Very soft subtle tiny UI tick for hovering over a target, quiet

lock.prompt: Satisfying plastic snap click of a small device locking into a wall mount, followed by a soft electronic confirm beep

scan.prompt: Friendly electronic sensor scanning sweep with rising digital beeps, cute sci-fi gadget for a kids game

correct.prompt: Cheerful bright correct-answer chime for a kids game, three quick ascending bell notes

needsFix.prompt: Gentle soft try-again sound for a kids game, two descending mellow boop notes, not harsh or scary

progress.prompt: Short sparkly ding notification for a kids game, a question popping up

complete.prompt: Triumphant short victory fanfare jingle with sparkles for a kids educational game, mission complete
